senses.gloss: एश् (1) the substitute ए for the per- fect affix त, substituted for the whole त by reason of the indica- tory letter श् attached to ए; cf. लिटस्तझयोरेशिरेच् and अनेकाल्शित्सर्वस्य P. III.4.8l and I.1.55; (2) affix ए applied to the root चक्ष् in Vedic Literature; cf. नावचक्षे । नावख्यातव्य- मित्यर्थः Kāś. on P.III.4.15.
